# Complete Candidate And Historical Input Repair

Bounded repairs in2604/2542, authorized by reviewer-b's inline ruling
https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/pull/2604#discussion_r4239590916
and the orchestrator's store-admission-full integration instruction.
No new migration family, runtime semantics, historical expectation, debt
allowance, workload, tier, timeout or budget changes.

## Candidate Owner

The existing checkTypes owner now derives sorted unique exact package patterns
from all pending file directories and loads the complete overlay with Tests:true.
Every pending Go file must occur in a typed active compiled-file variant.
Load/type/coverage errors refuse the entire candidate before applyPendingFiles
writes anything. Empty migrations remain inert. There is no hard-coded package
list, recursive load, platform union or build-exclusion fallback.

Real temporary-module controls reproduce false acceptance and actual invalid
writes under the old four-package owner: all three omitted packages, internal
and external tests, mixed good/bad batches and an excluded input. The corrected
controls pass under race: five roots/11 records. The consumer-only overlay
refuses; simultaneous cross-package replacements pass, with dry-run no-write
and exact write assertions. Stable scope also rejects duplicate/foreign/non-Go
inputs. The actual reviewed candidate overlay passes in the existing issue2413
build profile needed by its tagged fixture; the ordinary excluded-file hostile
control still refuses. Eight other affected finite/current/historical/retirement
roots pass (916 records); all893 recipe records remain byte-identical.
